chunks: You should say: Peace be upon you, O Guardian of Allah; Peace be upon you, O Proof of Allah; Peace be upon you, O Caliph of Allah; Peace be upon you, O Pillar of the Religion; Peace be upon you, O Inheritor of the Prophets; Peace be upon you, O Distributor of Paradise and Hell, and Owner of the Staff and the Branding Tool; Peace be upon you, O Amir al-Mu'minin.

I testify that you are the Word of Piety, the Door of Guidance, the Firmest Handle, the Strong Rope, and the Straight Path. And I testify that you are the Proof of Allah upon His creation, His witness upon His servants, His trustee over His knowledge, the Keeper of His secret, the place of His wisdom, and the brother of His Messenger (peace be upon him).

And I testify that your call is true, and every caller set up besides you is false and repelled. You are the first oppressed one, and the first whose right was usurped, so you were patient and reckoned. May Allah curse those who oppressed you and exceeded against you and turned away from you with a great curse, by which every near Angel, every sent Prophet, and every tested believing servant curse them.

May Allah send blessings upon you, O Amir al-Mu'minin, and may Allah send blessings upon your soul and body. I testify that you are the servant of Allah and His trustee; you delivered while advising, fulfilled while being trusted, were killed as a truthful one, and departed upon certainty. You did not prefer blindness over guidance, nor incline from truth to falsehood.

I testify that you established Salat, paid Zakat, enjoined good, forbade evil, followed the Messenger, advised the community, recited the Book with its true recitation, struggled in Allah's way as it was rightful, and called to His way with wisdom and goodly admonition until death (certainty) came to you.

I testify that you were upon clear proof from your Lord, called to Him with insight, delivered what you were commanded, and stood with the right of Allah without weakness or fatigue. So may Allah send upon you a blessing that follows, is continuous, and successive, one following another, with no interruption, no end, and no term. And peace be upon you, and the mercy and blessings of Allah. May Allah recompense you, O Truthful one, with good for your subjects.

I testify that Jihad with you is Jihad, and that Truth is with you and towards you, and you are its people and its mine, and the inheritance of Prophethood is with you. So may Allah send blessings upon you and grant abundant peace; and may Allah punish your killer with various types of punishment.

I have come to you, O Amir al-Mu'minin, knowing your right, perceiving your status, being an enemy to your enemies and a friend to your friends. May my father and mother be sacrificed for you! I have come to you seeking refuge with you from the Fire, which is deserved by one like me due to what I have committed against myself. I have come to you as a visitor, seeking through my visitation the emancipation of my neck from the Fire.

I have come to you fleeing from my sins, which I have loaded upon my back. I have come to you as a delegate due to your great status and position with my Lord. So intercede for me with your Lord, for I have many sins, and indeed you have a known position with Allah, a great status, a great affair, and accepted intercession. And Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has said: 'And they do not intercede except for the one whom He approves of.'

O Allah, Lord of the lords, Helper of the lovers! I have sought refuge with the brother of your Messenger with a refuge, so free my neck from the Fire. I believed in Allah and what was revealed to you, and I befriended the last of you as I befriended the first of you, and I rejected Al-Jibt and Al-Taghut, and Al-Lat and Al-Uzza.
ai.seo_question: What are the key titles and virtues of Imam Ali mentioned in the Dua at his grave?
ai.summary: This supplication, recorded in *Al-Kafi*, serves as a cornerstone of Shia devotional practice, emphasizing Imam Ali’s (AS) unique ontological status as the 'Proof of Allah' (Hujjatullah) and the inheritor of prophetic wisdom. It integrates theological testimony with personal supplication, highlighting the concept of *Tawassul* (seeking intercession) through the Imam’s accepted status, while affirming his fidelity in delivering the divine message without distortion.

en.hubeali: You should be saying, ‘The greetings be upon you<sup>asws</sup>, O Guardian (from) Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! The greetings be upon you<sup>asws</sup> O Proof of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! The greetings be upon you<sup>asws</sup> O Caliph of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! The greetings be upon you<sup>asws</sup>, O Pillar of the Religion! The greetings be upon you<sup>asws</sup>, O inheritor of the Prophets<sup>as</sup>! The greetings be upon you<sup>asws</sup>, O Distributor of the Garden and the Fire, and the owner of the staff (of Musa<sup>as</sup>) and the branding tool! (he is a Believer, and he is an Infidel). The greetings be upon you<sup>asws</sup> O Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>!

I hereby testify that youasws are the [48:26] the word of piety, and the door of guidance, and the [31:22] the Firmest Handle, and the strong rope, and [1:6] the Straight Path. And I testify that youasws are the Proof of Allahazwj upon Hisazwj creatures, and Hisazwj witness upon Hisazwj servants, and Hisazwj trustworthy upon Hisazwj Knowledge, and a Keeper of Hisazwj secrets, and a place of Hisazwj Wisdom, and a brother of Hisazwj Rasoolsaww.

And I testify that you<sup>asws</sup> call was True, and every call linked to those besides you<sup>asws</sup> is false, to be refuted. You<sup>asws</sup> are the first oppressed one, and the first one whose right was usurped, but you<sup>asws</sup> were patient and reckoned. May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Curse the ones who oppressed you<sup>asws</sup>, and exceeded upon you<sup>asws</sup>, and shut-off from you with numerous Curses, Cursed by the Angels of Proximity, and every Mursil Prophet<sup>as</sup>, and every Tested Believing servant.

May the Blessings be upon you<sup>asws</sup>, O Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>, and may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Send Blessings upon your<sup>asws</sup> soul, and your<sup>asws</sup> body. I testify that you<sup>asws</sup> are a servant of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and His<sup>azwj</sup> trustworthy one, having delivered the preaching, and fulfilled the entrustment, and were murdered while being a truthful one, and went upon certainty. You<sup>asws</sup> did not give preference to the blindness over the guidance, and did not incline away from the Truth towards the falsehood.

I testify that you established the Salaat and paid the Zakat, and enjoined with the goodness and forbade from the evil, and followed the Rasoolsaww, and preached to the community, and recited the Book with its rightful recitation, and struggled in the Way of Allahazwj as it was rightful, and called to Hisazwj Way with the wisdom and the goodly preaching until the conviction (death) came to youasws.

I testify that you were upon the Proof of your<sup>asws</sup> Lord<sup>azwj</sup>, and called to Him<sup>azwj</sup> upon an insight, and delivered what you<sup>asws</sup> were Commanded with, and stood with the Right of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> without any weakness or hesitation. So may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Send Blessings upon you, consecutively, continuously, in tandem, one following the other, there being no interruption to it, nor a time, nor a term. And the greetings be upon you<sup>asws</sup>, and Mercy of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and His<sup>azwj</sup> Blessings, and may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Recompense you<sup>asws</sup> due to your<sup>asws</sup> sincere goodness about His<sup>azwj</sup> citizens.

I testify that the Jihad performed alongside you<sup>asws</sup> is a Jihaad, and that the Truth is with you<sup>asws</sup>, and to you<sup>asws</sup>, and you<sup>asws</sup> are its rightful one, and its mine, and the inheritance of the Prophet-hood is with you<sup>asws</sup>. So may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Send Blessings upon you<sup>asws</sup>, and greetings with abundance greetings; and may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Punish your<sup>asws</sup> murderer with the varieties of the Punishments.

I come to youasws, O Amir Al-Momineenasws, a recogniser of yourasws right, and with an insight about youasws, an enemy to yourasws enemies, a friend of yourasws friends. May my father and my mother be sacrificed for youasws! I come to you seeking refuge with youasws from a Fire Prepared for the likes of me due to what I have committed against myself. I come to youasws as a visitor seeking by yourasws Ziyarah, an emancipation (liberation) of my neck from the Fire.

I come to youasws fleeing from my sins, which I have loaded upon my back. I come to youasws as a delegate due to yourasws magnificent status and position in the Presence of my Lordazwj. Therefore, intercede for me in the Presence of yourasws Lordazwj, for there are numerous sins upon me, and that for youasws, in the Presence of Allahazwj, is a well-known position, and a magnificent status, and a great glory, and an Accepted intercession. And Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic has Said [21:28] and they will not be interceding except for the one whom He Approves of.

O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Lord<sup>azwj</sup> of the lords! Helper of the Loved ones! I hereby seek refuge with the brother<sup>asws</sup> of Your<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup> with a refuge, therefore Save my neck from the Fire. I believe in Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and whatever was Revelaed upon you<sup>asws</sup> and I befriend the last ones of you<sup>asws</sup> with what I befriended the first ones of you<sup>asws</sup>, and I reject with the false idols, and the tyrants, and Al-Laat and Al-Uzza (first and the second one are referred to with these names in the Ahadith – the names of idols they used to worship)’.
